status: qualified for build d05939967b5f (55 prefill + 84 decode/MTP); full-grid re-measure 2026-10-14: 11 rows added at M=256/512/800, 2 solvers replaced, decode grid re-verified against the heuristic
storage_policy: Visible sibling profile (not archived). Registered in ../profiles.json; configure_tunableop auto-selects it when the loaded librocblas.so.5 hashes to d05939967b5f, or when TUNABLEOP_PROFILE=rocm10-rocblas5.6 is set (validated against the loaded lib). 128 rows/rank = the curated prefill grid (44) plus a decode/MTP grid (84) tuned and qualified for this build.

imported.note: retired build; superseded by the campaign below

campaign.method: 4 GPUs tuned in parallel (10 iters, 25 ms budget); heuristic / current / new measured in one session; curated with 3% adopt and 3% drop margins.
campaign.candidates: current = tunableop/rocblas-d05939967b5f rows (same build); new = fresh tune on this build
campaign.measurement_note: Same-session repeats agree to ~0.3% median (|d|>3% on 1/70). Across sessions the same row set drifts 5-10%, so adopt/drop margins are only meaningful within one session.
campaign.finding: ours / imported / curated_v2 all measure within 0.9% of each other; all ~4% faster than the heuristic on median.

campaign_decode.why: The prefill-grid campaign left every M <= 32 shape untuned, so on this build all decode and MTP-verify GEMMs fell back to rocBLAS heuristics. The canonical rocm7.14-rocblas5.5 profile carries those shapes; this one did not.
campaign_decode.method: Tuned on GPU 0 (10 iterations, 10 ms budget per solver, numerics checked vs FP32 in-process), then replayed on all four cards against FP32 references.
campaign_decode.solver_mix: 81 Gemm_Rocblas_*, 3 Default (the heuristic won for tn_4096_8, tn_3584_7, tn_3584_8)
campaign_decode.speedups: Per-shape speedup over the heuristic ranged 1.4x to 3.6x; the largest were the K=320 and K=10240 shapes (up to 3.57x at M=16 n=10240 k=320).
campaign_decode.note: Rows are raw tuned, not curated: the prefill grid's adopt/drop margins need a same-session heuristic-vs-current-vs-new comparison, which was not run here. They cover M values disjoint from the prefill grid, so they only add.

campaign_full_grid.why: (a) the coverage checker reported 7 of the 14 shapes required by the live cache/batch config (block 1024, max-num-batched-tokens 2048) as missing, and the 26 prefill shapes dropped by the 2026-10-12 curation were never re-tested because the pipeline only tunes shapes present in --shape-source; (b) the live launcher sets VLLM_RDNA_DYNAMIC_PREFILL=1, whose chunk-cap ladder (RUNGS=256,512,1024) can put M=256/512 chunks on the wire at >=4 eligible requests, and no row covered them.
campaign_full_grid.pipeline: tools/rdna2_028/tunableop_rows_pipeline.sh PHASE=all, SHAPE_SRC=<our 128 rows | the 40 missing keys> = 168 shapes, PROFILE=rocm10-rocblas5.6
campaign_full_grid.method: tuned on all 4 GPUs in parallel (10 iterations, 25 ms budget), then heuristic / current / new measured in ONE session on device 0 (warmup 5, reps 15) so the 3% adopt/drop margins are not compared across sessions.

findings.live_grid_holes: none of the 7 required-but-missing shapes (M=1024: 10240x320, 4096x2560, 2560x1536, 3584x2560; M=2048: 10240x320, 512x2560, 10240x2560) was beaten by a fresh tune - the rocBLAS heuristic ties or wins on every one, so they stay absent. An explicit `Default` row would only silence the coverage warning without changing behaviour.
findings.real_wins: 11 new rows at M=256/512/800, all on shapes with no row. The M=256/512 large-K shapes are the big ones: 10240x2560 4.33->1.22 ms (-72%), 336x10240 1.05->0.24 ms (-77%), 512x2560 0.229->0.102 ms (-55%); the new solver reaches ~22 TFLOPS where the heuristic managed ~6.
findings.solver_replacements: 2 shipped prefill rows were replaced by a different, faster solver (10240x2560 at M=1024, 2560x1536 at M=3200). Two further adopt decisions carried the SAME solver id as the shipped row - i.e. same-session noise, not a better kernel - and were rejected.
findings.decode_grid_protected: 18 decode/MTP rows (M=2..8) measured 10-77% slower than the heuristic, but that region is launch-bound: identical shape families flip sign between M=1 (row 22-58% faster) and M=2..8, on ~14 MFLOP GEMMs timed at 80-240 us. The decode grid is therefore left byte-identical to what shipped; the 18 need a small-M measurement (no per-call sync, larger reps) before any deletion.
findings.harness_quirk: on a key absent from --rows the `current` arm does not reproduce the `heuristic` arm (up to +46% slower), so hole 'drop' verdicts are meaningless. The adopt verdicts are unaffected: they require beating min(current, heuristic).

campaign_full_grid.qualification: qualify_v620_fp16.py: 139/139 rows matched independent FP32 on devices 0-3 (relative L2 < 0.002, assert_close atol/rtol 0.01). Rank files are identical (rank 0's set); 4-7 keys per rank had picked a different solver in the same-session tune, all within noise.
